cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(NeuRoticFullV1Sdk LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(FFX_API_BACKEND DX12_X64 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION ON)
add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../FidelityFX-SDK/ffx-api" original-api)
# Preserve original provider/algorithm sources and all shader generation rules.
# These query functions intentionally publish UNSUPPORTED only.
target_sources(amd_fidelityfx_dx12 PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../CheckedSdkExports.cpp")
target_sources(amd_fidelityfx_dx12 PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../CheckedExperimentalService.cpp")
target_link_options(amd_fidelityfx_dx12 PRIVATE /EXPORT:ffxNeuRoticQueryClosureServiceV1 /EXPORT:ffxNeuRoticQueryDispatchServiceV1)
target_link_options(amd_fidelityfx_dx12 PRIVATE /EXPORT:ffxNeuRoticQueryExperimentalServiceV1)
target_sources(amd_fidelityfx_dx12 PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../CheckedControlledService.cpp")
target_link_options(amd_fidelityfx_dx12 PRIVATE /EXPORT:ffxNeuRoticQueryControlledServiceV1)
function(nr_keep_outputs directory)
  get_property(targets DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
  foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
    get_target_property(kind "${target}" TYPE)
    if(NOT kind STREQUAL "UTILITY" AND NOT kind STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
      set_target_properties("${target}" PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 20)
      foreach(config DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO)
        set_target_properties("${target}" PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin" ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
      endforeach()
    endif()
  endforeach()
  get_property(children DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY SUBDIRECTORIES)
  foreach(child IN LISTS children)
    nr_keep_outputs("${child}")
  endforeach()
endfunction()
nr_keep_outputs("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
